title: Villager file (data/villagers/<id>.json, one villager per file)
description: A villager the hero can befriend (GDD §10, TECH_DESIGN §24): who they are, which conversation is theirs, what they like to be given, and what they say to a gift. A villager is known by their conversation: a Villager node with that dialogue_id is this villager, so no two villagers may share one. What talk and gifts are worth is in data/rules/friendship.json.

name.description: As the Friends page and their words of thanks name them: "Farmer Oda".

dialogue.description: The id of their conversation in data/dialogue.

likes.description: Item ids they like to be given. Each must be an item that can be given (a type in the friendship rules' gift_types). May be empty.

thanks.description: What they say to a gift, shown after their name.

full.description: To any gift once the friendship is full (five marks): it is still taken, and this is said in place of the other two.
